capabilities: Draw handwriting with stylus, mouse, or finger, with pressure-aware stroke thickness
Erase strokes and select, move, or delete them
Pan and zoom an infinite canvas and save view position with the note
Choose colors and stroke widths, including a custom palette
Create whiteboards as .pencil JSON files via ribbon icon or command
disambiguation: Not a diagramming or note-editing tool; it only handles freehand strokes saved as .pencil JSON files.
extras: The author links a Ko-fi donation request and lists unrelated personal projects (Maibook, maiweb, ollamadash). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Pencil is an opinionated, single-slice take on handwriting in Obsidian.
motivation: The author wanted an opinionated, minimal handwriting tool: 'The existing whiteboard apps are heavy and loaded with features most people never touch.'
problem: Obsidian has no built-in freehand handwriting surface, and the author considers existing whiteboard apps too heavy with unused features.
summary: Infinite-canvas whiteboard for freehand drawing and handwriting with a stylus, mouse, or finger, saved as .pencil JSON files in the vault.
